source_policy: Primary PTV documentation and maintainer source only; public documentation plus attached exact parent code. No access to installed live Visum COM.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: IOperations
sources.supported_point: Operations are identified by 1-based position, not a network NO attribute.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: IOperations members
sources.supported_point: GetAll property, ItemByKey, GetParent/GetChildren; Count is not a documented member.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: OperationType
sources.supported_point: PrT assignment101; PuT100; TG45; TD46; script65; group75; PrT skims103.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: CreatePrTPathList
sources.supported_point: Read-only object property. Official Python uses SetObjects(0,"C",0) and explicit AddColumn key IDs.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: ILists
sources.supported_point: Distinct path, path-link and assignment-quality list properties.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: GetMultiAttValues
sources.supported_point: Returned keys are GetAll indices, not object numbers. OnlyActive defaults True; pass False for full scope.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: SetMultiAttValues
sources.supported_point: Third argument Add=False means replacement; it is NOT an OnlyActive selector.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: IOperation members
sources.supported_point: Typed TG/TD/PrT parameter object properties are distinct.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: AddMatrix
sources.supported_point: Official example creates zone demand matrix using ObjectTypeRef2, MatrixType3.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: IMatrix attributes
sources.supported_point: MatrixType, DataSourceType and ObjectTypeRef are different attributes. NumRows/NumCols are read-only outputs. MatrixUnit is maintained separately.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: AddUserDefinedAttribute
sources.supported_point: Examples: integer1, float2, text5, Boolean9. Existing correct types were not replaced with Vissim enums.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM: GetPath
sources.supported_point: Returns configured project directory for file type; not necessarily the full loaded version filename.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026: integrating scripts
sources.supported_point: Standard3.13 supports COM. Hub does not. Legacy script-file execution can use a wx thread. LoadVersion forbidden inside a running procedure sequence.

sources.title: PTV support: COM documentation
sources.supported_point: Installed COM help and COM examples are the exact local reference where public pages omit details.

sources.title: pywin32 maintainer source: dynamic.py
sources.supported_point: CDispatch.__call__ invokes the default member. callable(COM property) does not imply a factory that should be called again.

sources.title: PTV Visum 2026 COM object library overview
sources.supported_point: Confirms interface names for type-library extraction; does not establish every parameter attribute signature.
